args.body:
- Temperature excursions in cold-chain logistics fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion
args.title: Cold-chain 2026: Combined Summary (Brightline blog + companion)
